purpose: isolated experimental profile; not a production configuration
server_parallelism: not changed; OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL not present in observed server environment; effective behavior not measured
gpu_placement: automatic; no guarantee of full GPU placement

profiling_admission.rule: Three samples plus model-specific bounded load peak, commit peak, OS reserve and measured abort margin. Missing bounds mean BLOCKED.
profiling_admission.reason: No defensible 4B-specific memory peak, reserve or stop-latency bound; disk file size and idle free VRAM do not bound cold-start host RAM.

integration: OLLAMA_MODEL supports selection in a separate process; provider and server do not currently guarantee all experimental settings; no production switch made.
